title: 1-Hour E-Bike Rental in Austin
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Hop on our pedal-assist electric bike, let us show you the map, and go create your own Austin adventure! Using an electric bike is the best way to navigate and see the most in Austin. You can cover more ground with less effort than a traditional bike. 

If you want to keep the e-bike past one hour, we will pro-rate to the nearest 5-minute increment, and after 3 hours you stop being charged.
